open_points.subject: Model M13 — ServicePrincipal credential issuance while disabled
open_points.text: “re-enabling restores none of them, so a re-enabled principal needs a newly issued credential” does not say whether an administrator may issue that new ServiceCredential while the principal is still disabled
open_points.question: May an administrator issue a ServiceCredential for a disabled ServicePrincipal, leaving it unusable until re-enablement, or must credential issuance wait until the principal is active?
options: Credential issuance is refused while the ServicePrincipal is disabled.
A credential may be created while disabled but cannot authenticate until the principal is re-enabled.
open_points.default_guess: Refuse credential issuance while the ServicePrincipal is disabled.

witness.initial: A ServicePrincipal is disabled, and disabling it has revoked all its credentials.
events: An administrator attempts to issue a replacement credential before re-enabling the principal.
outcomes: The operation creates a new ServiceCredential; it remains unusable until the principal is re-enabled.
The operation is refused and no ServiceCredential is created until after re-enablement.

open_points.subject: Model M13 — ServicePrincipal project grants under all-project scope
open_points.text: “with it the scope mode alone admits an import for any project the Registry reports active, and no project grant is consulted” and M15’s “consulted only when the principal's scope_mode is granted_projects” do not say whether the grant action may create a ProducerProjectGrant for an all_projects principal
open_points.question: Must creation of a ProducerProjectGrant be refused when the ServicePrincipal has scope_mode = all_projects, or may such an inert grant be stored and audited?
options: Reject grant creation unless scope_mode is granted_projects.
Allow the grant to be created and audited, but ignore it for authorization while scope_mode is all_projects.
open_points.default_guess: Reject grant creation for an all_projects principal.

witness.initial: An active ServicePrincipal has scope_mode = all_projects, and an active Registry project has no ProducerProjectGrant for it.
events: An administrator invokes the producer-project grant action for that project.
outcomes: A new ProducerProjectGrant is stored and audited but has no authorization effect.
The action is refused and no ProducerProjectGrant is created.
